=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:LAST RUN DIFF hunk @@ -712,10 +712,10 @@ (label-check and engine-source guard) | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN tightens the preflight so `any_claude=true` only fires when no tracking issue has `ai:codex` (label check) and `ai_engine.sh` is only sourced when no issue has `ai:codex` (engine source). The first guard has a logical asymmetry: the label iteration is `any(.[]; ...engine-claude... and (any...ai:codex) | not)`, which is correct (`ai:codex` wins), but the engine-source guard uses a separate `all(.labels[]?; .name != "ai:codex")` over the same issue set. The two guards compute over the same `tracking_issues.json` but with different jq paths.
  WHY: It does not. The change is a defensive narrowing that prevents a wasted `source` when `ai:codex` is present. The asymmetry is a minor code-clarity nit, not a correctness defect. Fail-open to `ai_engine_for_role` returning `codex` is the documented fallback.
- tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py:LAST RUN DIFF — test additions in `test_poll_preflight_installs_for_label_even_with_global_codex` | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN added three preflight cases and one multi-project scenario, but does not add the three specific vacuous-truth cases requested: `("claude", ["ai:engine-claude"], "true")`, `("claude", [], "true")`, and `("codex", [], "false")`.
  WHY: The empty-issues path is not exercised. With no issues, the second `jq -e` returns false (because `any` over an empty array is false), the `source` block is skipped, and `any_claude` stays `false`. That is the correct outcome for the engine-source guard. The pre-existing case list was just two entries; the LAST RUN adds three more for the conflicting-label path, which is the higher-risk path. The vacuous-truth path is a NIT-grade gap because the production runtime never has zero tracking issues at the preflight step.
- README.md and agents.md (LAST RUN DIFF) | severity=low | confidence=[1]
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN rewrites the `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK` sentence in README from "the same attempt runs the unchanged codex call, and the rest of the job stays on codex" to "the same attempt runs its codex/OpenCode fallback. Poller judges retry OpenCode in a fresh isolated sandbox, never host Codex." The agents.md table footer likewise adds the poller-judge line.
  WHY: It does not — it is purely a doc fix. There is no behavior change in the LAST RUN, but the docs now describe the behavior that the PR implemented and that the consensus task gap correctly observed. The text is now correct relative to the documented security contract that PR-derived judge prompts must run only in credential-free sandboxes.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml — preflight engine-source guard at `if [ -f scripts/ai_engine.sh ] && jq -e '...' ...` | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The preflight sources `scripts/ai_engine.sh` only when present and when no issue has `ai:codex`, but the `source` is not wrapped in an explicit exit-status check.
  WHY: If `scripts/ai_engine.sh` exists but is malformed, the role loop below it will print `codex` for every role and the operator will not see a Claude-specific failure; the fall-through is documented as fail-open to codex, so this is a hardening gap rather than a correctness break.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
